body: Done in 3bb21193 (PromptCacheSim/index.tsx and styles.module.css). Each turn is now one row: the pause, a clock since the first message, then the 5-minute and 1-hour caches side by side, each with what happened, this turn's cost and the total so far. The cheaper total so far is in bold, so you can see the 1-hour cache pull ahead at turn 3. On a phone each row becomes a small card with the two caches side by side. After picture attached. One note: the '1 min' in every pause box in your picture comes from the comment tool's screenshot, which draws every dropdown at its first option. The live page had the right pauses.
